pm_exper_user_3675_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You might enjoy starting your mornings with accounts like @NationalGeographicTravel, @EarthPix, and @LonelyPlanet — they share stunning travel photography, interesting cultural tidbits, and little glimpses of places you might dream of visiting one day. They’re a lovely burst of wanderlust and inspiration to set the tone for the day.
(b) You might enjoy starting your mornings with accounts like @BollywoodHungama, @MasalaWithMegha, and @DesiComedyProject — they share fun movie news, lighthearted cultural humor, and energy-filled videos that bring a smile. They’re a lively burst of South Asian flair to set the tone for the day.
(c) You might enjoy starting your mornings with accounts like @TheDodo, @SusiesSeniorDogs, and @PawsofHopeRescue — they share heartwarming rescue stories, joyful adoption updates, and little reminders of the good we can do for animals. They’re a lovely burst of positivity with a dose of compassion to set the tone for the day.
(d) You might enjoy starting your mornings with accounts like @GoodNewsMovement, @Upworthy, and @TanksGoodNews — they share uplifting stories, moments of kindness, and inspiring human achievements. They’re a lovely burst of optimism to set the tone for the day.
